name: Forward Thrust
what: Accelerates the ship along its current facing vector.
when: Traversing space or closing distance to a target.
cue: Target or destination is ahead and distance needs to close.
done_check: Background starfield moves opposite to facing; fuel bar is unaffected.

name: Reverse Thrust and Shed Speed
what: Decelerates the ship by turning to retrograde and thrusting (or firing reverse thrusters if installed). Note: Disagreement between A and B — B claims Shift+S is full stop, but A verified keys.txt has no default binding for Stop; Down arrow or land autopilot (l) is the verified default.
when: Shedding speed near a destination, asteroid, or maintaining distance from a target.
cue: Ship is moving too fast toward an obstacle or target.
done_check: Ship turns retrograde and starfield motion slows to a halt.

name: Port Rotation
what: Rotates the ship counter-clockwise.
when: Aligning forward weapons or thrust vector to the left.
cue: Desired heading or target lead indicator is counter-clockwise from current facing.
done_check: Ship sprite rotates counter-clockwise.

name: Starboard Rotation
what: Rotates the ship clockwise.
when: Aligning forward weapons or thrust vector to the right.
cue: Desired heading or target lead indicator is clockwise from current facing.
done_check: Ship sprite rotates clockwise.

name: Mouse Steering
what: Turns the ship toward the mouse cursor.
when: Precision aiming or turning without using keyboard arrow keys.
how: Hold LShift and move the mouse.
cue: Need continuous angular tracking toward a screen point.
done_check: Ship sprite rotates to track the cursor position.

name: Autosteer Hold
what: Automatically turns the ship toward TargetAim (lead point for current target, asteroid, or stellar object). Note: Disagreement between A and B — B calls `e` a toggle, but A verified in AI.cpp (`activeCommands.Has(AUTOSTEER)`) that `e` must be held down.
when: Dogfighting a selected target or aligning with a selected asteroid or planet.
cue: A valid ship, asteroid, or stellar target is bracketed.
done_check: Ship automatically rotates to face the target or its lead indicator while `e` is held.

name: Newtonian Drift
what: Coasting in a vacuum without applying thrust, preserving momentum while generating zero engine heat.
when: Shedding heat or sliding along a vector while turning to face another direction.
cue: Ship has sufficient velocity and heat bar at x -13.5 is rising.
done_check: Ship maintains velocity across starfield while heat bar recedes.

name: Inertial Pivot
what: Turning 180 degrees while drifting so the ship faces backward along its travel vector.
when: Firing forward guns at a pursuing enemy while retreating.
how: Release Up arrow, hold Left or Right arrow (or hold `e` with pursuer targeted) until facing 180 degrees from travel vector.
cue: Fast enemy is pursuing along your velocity vector.
done_check: Ship travels backward relative to the starfield while facing the pursuer.

name: Afterburner Pulse
what: Rapidly accelerates the ship at a high energy, fuel, or heat cost (if an afterburner outfit is installed).
when: Evading incoming missiles, breaking target locks, or escaping fatal encounters.
cue: White missile blips on radar or hull dropping near retreat threshold.
done_check: Speed bursts upward; energy/fuel drops and heat bar spikes.

name: Cloaking and Uncloaking
what: Renders the ship invisible to radar and enemy targeting at an energy/heat cost, or uncloaks to resume firing.
when: Escaping fatal encounters or positioning for an ambush (requires Cloaking Device).
how: Press `c` to cloak; press `c` again to uncloak.
cue: Shields depleted and heavy fire incoming, or ready to ambush.
done_check: Ship sprite turns translucent and energy drains when cloaked; sprite solidifies when uncloaked.

name: Autopilot Jump and Route Following
what: Stops, aligns, and jumps to the linked system or along a plotted travel plan, and automatically lands if the plan names a destination planet.
when: Traveling to an adjacent system or executing a multi-jump route.
cue: Fuel bar has at least 100 units (1/3 of a 300-unit Sparrow tank) and a target system or travel plan is set.
done_check: Ship decelerates, aligns, jumps with a flash, and displays 'Autopilot: landing on ...' at the final system.

name: Three-Jump Fuel Budget Check
what: Verifies fuel capacity before jumping so the ship is never stranded in an uninhabited system (a Sparrow holds 300 fuel and each hyperdrive jump costs 100).
when: Before pressing `j` or plotting a route through systems without refueling ports.
how: Check fuel bar at HUD x -53.5 (192 px total length; each jump uses 1/3 of the bar on a Sparrow) or read fuel in save file.
cue: About to depart or jump into a system.
done_check: Remaining fuel after planned jumps reaches a system with an inhabited planet or sufficient reserve to return.

name: Autopilot Land
what: Flies to the targeted or nearest landable planet, decelerates, and lands.
when: Completing a mission, refueling, repairing, saving the game, or retreating from combat.
cue: In a system with a friendly/neutral landable planet and hull is above the 45% disabled threshold.
done_check: 'Autopilot: landing on ...' message appears, ship docks, and PlanetPanel opens.

name: Multi-Planet Landing Cycle
what: Cycles through landable planets/stations in a system with multiple stellar objects.
when: System contains more than one habitable planet or station and you need a specific one.
how: Tap `l` to select the first planet, tap `l` again while selecting to cycle to the next, then press `l` to initiate landing.
done_check: Target message 'Autopilot: landing on <Planet>' matches the desired destination.

name: Autopilot Board
what: Approaches and matches velocity with the targeted disabled ship to initiate boarding or repair.
when: Target ship is disabled (grey on radar).
cue: Targeted ship is grey on radar and hull ring is at disabled level.
done_check: Ship maneuvers onto target and BoardingPanel opens (or friendly ship is repaired).

name: Jump or Landing Autopilot Abort
what: Cancels an active jump spin-up or landing approach.
when: Ambushed during landing/jump prep or realizing the destination is wrong.
how: Press Up, Left, or Right arrow to override autopilot with manual control.
cue: Autopilot is active but immediate evasion is required.
done_check: Ship responds immediately to manual steering or thrust.

name: Asteroid Braking
what: Uses physical impact or friction with asteroids when emergency deceleration is needed.
when: Emergency speed reduction when engines are overheated or insufficient.
done_check: Velocity drops sharply upon contact.

name: Wormhole Entry
what: Transits through a wormhole anomaly to a distant system without hyperlanes.
when: Navigating Remnant, Hai, or deep alien space via wormholes.
how: Press `l` or `j` when targeting/approaching a wormhole.
cue: Wormhole stellar object is present in system.
done_check: Screen flashes/transitions and ship arrives in the linked system.

name: Ramscoop Solar Hovering
what: Drifts close to the central star to harvest hyperspace fuel via intrinsic or installed ramscoop.
when: Out of fuel in an uninhabited system.
how: Fly close to the system's star and release thrust to hold position.
cue: Fuel bar (x -53.5) is below 100 units and no refueling planet is available.
done_check: Fuel bar slowly fills over time.

name: Harvest Flotsam
what: Uses autopilot to fly over and scoop up floating cargo or mined ore.
when: Destroyed ships or mined asteroids drop flotsam boxes in space.
cue: Flotsam sprites visible in space and free cargo capacity > 0.
done_check: Ship flies over flotsam and message log shows cargo collected.

name: In-Flight Help Dialog Dismissal
what: Detects and dismisses first-time modal help popups ('Navigation', 'Lost 1/2/3', etc.) that block flight controls.
when: First time entering space, jumping, or running low on fuel on a new pilot.
how: Press Return to close the dialog before sending flight keys.
cue: Centered modal dialog box covers the space view during flight.
done_check: Dialog box disappears and subsequent flight keys act on the ship.

name: Cycle Next Ship
what: Cycles targeting through non-disabled ships in the current system.
when: Scanning local space or selecting a specific vessel.
cue: Multiple ships in system and need to inspect or hail one.
done_check: Target panel at top left updates with the newly selected ship's silhouette and rings.

name: Target Nearest Hostile
what: Snaps target lock to the closest hostile ship or mission target.
when: Entering combat or switching to the next immediate threat.
cue: Red or yellow blips appear on the top-left radar.
done_check: Closest red/yellow radar blip is bracketed and shown in the top-left target panel.

name: Target Nearest Non-Hostile
what: Targets the nearest friendly or neutral ship.
when: Looking for an ally to hail for fuel/repairs or to repair via boarding.
cue: Blue blips on radar when needing fuel or assistance.
done_check: Top-left target panel displays a friendly/neutral vessel.

name: Target Own Escorts
what: Cycles target lock through the player's own fleet escorts.
when: Checking escort shield/hull health during or after combat.
cue: Green blips on radar and player owns escort vessels.
done_check: Top-left target panel shows an owned escort's shields and hull.

name: Target Nearest Asteroid
what: Selects the nearest minable asteroid.
when: Asteroid mining or checking nearby rock trajectories.
cue: In a system with minable asteroids.
done_check: Nearest minable asteroid is bracketed on screen.

name: Scan Target Cargo or Outfits
what: Scans the targeted ship for cargo or outfits using installed scanners.
when: Completing surveillance missions or inspecting a target before boarding.
how: Hold `s` while within scanner range of the target.
cue: Target ship is within scanner range and player has a Cargo or Outfit Scanner.
done_check: Scan progress completes and cargo/outfit dialog or message appears.

name: Primary Weapons Fire with Auto-Aim
what: Fires primary guns/beams and triggers built-in automatic aiming when the target is within facing cos >= 0.8 (default preference 'Automatic aiming: when firing').
when: Target is within weapon range and roughly within the forward firing cone (cos >= 0.8).
cue: Enemy ship is targeted, within range (e.g., <= 300 px for Beam Laser), and within ~36 degrees of nose.
done_check: Beams or projectiles fire, ship fine-aims onto target, energy bar drops, and target shield/hull ring depletes.

name: Sparrow Close-In Beam Brawl vs Scrapper
what: Closes inside 300 pixels to defeat a Twin Blaster Scrapper using the Sparrow's superior agility, shields (1400 vs 450), and beam DPS. Note: Disagreement between A and B — B claims Beam Laser (range 300) outranges Twin Blaster and advises kiting at 295 px, but A verified in data/human/weapons.txt that Twin Blaster has range override 510 vs Beam Laser range 300; kiting at 295 is impossible, so the Sparrow must close inside 300 px.
when: Flying a stock Sparrow (2 Beam Lasers, range 300) against a Bounty Scrapper (Twin Blaster, range 510).
how: Press `r` to target Scrapper, hold `e` (autosteer) + `Up` (thrust) to close within 300 px quickly, then hold `e` + `Tab` to keep continuous beams on the Scrapper until its 450 shields and 520 hull collapse.
cue: Target panel shows Scrapper variant in a Bounty Hunting (Very Tiny) mission.
done_check: Scrapper shields drop in ~4 seconds of continuous beam contact, hull drops to disabled/destroyed, and bounty dialog appears.

name: Secondary Weapon Select and Fire
what: Cycles through installed secondary weapons (missiles, torpedoes, rockets) and launches them.
when: Needing burst damage from range or breaking heavy shields.
how: Press `w` to select secondary weapon type; press or hold `q` to fire; press `u` to toggle AI ammo usage.
cue: Target is locked at missile range and secondary ammo count > 0.
done_check: Missile sprite launches toward target and secondary ammo counter decreases.

name: Hold Fire Toggle
what: Toggles automatic turret firing on or off.
when: Conserving energy/heat or preventing turrets from destroying a disabled ship you intend to board.
cue: Target is nearly disabled or energy is critically low.
done_check: Message log confirms hold fire state and turrets cease auto-firing.

name: Deploy and Recall Fighters/Drones
what: Launches carried fighters/drones from bays for combat or orders them to dock.
when: Entering combat with a carrier, or recalling craft before jumping/fleeing.
how: Press `d` to deploy; press `d` again to recall.
cue: Player owns fighter/drone bays and hostiles are present (or cleared).
done_check: Carried craft emerge from hull into space, or return and dock inside bays.

name: Split and Isolate Enemy Pack
what: Draws faster ships away from slower pack mates to fight enemies one at a time instead of brawling a cluster.
when: Facing multiple hostile ships simultaneously (e.g., Sparrow + Fury in escort missions).
how: Thrust away from the hostile cluster until the fastest interceptor separates from the heavier ship, then pivot and engage the lone lead pursuer.
cue: Multiple red/yellow blips clustered together on radar.
done_check: One red blip separates from the rest on radar, allowing an isolated 1v1 fight.

name: Long-Range Kiting
what: Maintains distance between your weapon's maximum range and the enemy's shorter weapon range when your loadout truly outranges theirs.
when: Equipped with long-range weapons against shorter-range enemies.
how: Build velocity away from the target, pivot to face them (or use turrets), and regulate thrust so distance stays just inside your max range.
cue: Player weapon range exceeds target's weapon range.
done_check: Your shots land on target while enemy projectiles expire before reaching your ship.

name: Maneuvering Behind Non-Turreted Ships
what: Stays in the rear arc of slower ships that rely on fixed forward guns.
when: Fighting less maneuverable warships with fixed forward batteries.
how: Match position behind the enemy's stern using thrust and rotation.
cue: Target has slow turn rate and forward-facing guns.
done_check: Enemy cannot bring its nose to bear while your weapons continuously hit its stern.

name: Asteroid Missile Screening
what: Positions asteroids between your ship and incoming missiles so the warheads detonate on the rocks.
when: White missile blips are closing on radar in an asteroid field.
how: Steer behind dense asteroid sprites relative to the incoming white radar blip.
cue: White missile blips on radar and asteroids nearby.
done_check: Missile impacts asteroid sprite and explodes harmlessly.

name: Heat and Energy Bar Budgeting
what: Monitors HUD energy (x -33.5) and heat (x -13.5) bars (192 px long) and pauses firing or thrusting before overheating shuts down ship systems.
when: Continuously during any combat engagement or afterburner use.
how: Read fill level of energy (x -33.5) and heat (x -13.5) from top-right HUD; release `Tab` and `Up` if heat approaches maximum.
cue: Heat bar at x -13.5 approaches full length (192 px) or energy bar at x -33.5 empties.
done_check: Heat bar drops back down without triggering an overheat shutdown.

name: Enemy Overheating with Heat Weapons
what: Uses heat-generating weapons (e.g., Flamethrowers, Korath thermal weapons) after collapsing enemy shields to spike enemy core heat, stalling their energy and engines.
when: Attempting to disable and board high-value warships without destroying their hull.
how: Strip target shields first (heat damage is reduced while shields are up), then fire heat weapons until the target stops thrusting and firing.
cue: Target shield ring is at 0% and hull is still above disable threshold.
done_check: Target ship stops maneuvering and firing due to thermal shutdown.

name: Shield Regeneration Stalling
what: Fires periodic shots at an enemy to reset their shield regeneration delay when your own energy is low.
when: Low on energy during a prolonged duel against a shield-regenerating target.
how: Tap `Tab` briefly every ~1-2 seconds while letting your own energy recover.
cue: Own energy bar is low and target shield ring is at 0%.
done_check: Target shield ring remains at 0% while your energy bar recovers.

name: Enemy Disable Recognition
what: Stops firing immediately when an enemy transitions to the disabled state so it can be boarded or left alive.
when: Enemy hull ring drops to its disable threshold.
how: Release `Tab` and `q` the instant the target's radar blip and target reticle turn grey.
cue: Target blip on radar turns grey and ship stops moving/firing.
done_check: Target remains intact and grey on radar, ready for `b` (board).

name: Early Retreat Above 45% Hull Threshold
what: Initiates retreat or planetary landing well before hull reaches 45% (134/300 on a Sparrow), because a disabled ship cannot land or jump.
when: Shield ring at (-75, 155) is depleted (0%) and hull ring approaches 60%.
how: Cease firing, turn away from red radar blips, and press `l` to land on a local planet (or `j` to jump out) before hull hits 45%.
cue: Shield ring is empty and hull ring drops near 60%.
done_check: Ship successfully lands on a planet or jumps out before hitting 134/300 hull.

name: Planetary Landing Aggro Reset
what: Lands on any friendly or neutral planet in the system to instantly recharge shields/hull and reset non-scripted local hostilities.
when: Overwhelmed by pirates or low on shields in an inhabited system.
how: Press `l` (and optionally `CapsLock` for fast-forward once safe from fire) to land.
cue: Multiple red blips attacking and a friendly landable planet is in the system.
done_check: PlanetPanel opens, save file updates, and shields/hull are restored to 100%.

name: Boarding Plunder (Cargo and Outfits)
what: Takes valuable outfits or commodities from a boarded disabled enemy without risking a crew capture fight.
when: BoardingPanel is open on a disabled enemy and player has free cargo space.
how: After pressing `b` to board, use Up/Down to highlight high-value outfits or cargo, press `t` to take, then press `d` or `x` to leave.
cue: BoardingPanel is open showing enemy outfits/cargo list and free cargo space.
done_check: Selected item disappears from enemy list, player cargo space decreases, and BoardingPanel closes cleanly on exit.

name: Boarding Capture Arithmetic and Execution
what: Compares player attack odds against enemy 2x crew defense in the BoardingPanel and executes capture or defensive retreat.
when: BoardingPanel is open and player wants to capture the disabled ship intact.
how: Read attack/defense odds and crew counts in BoardingPanel; ensure total player crew exceeds the sum of both ships' minimum crew requirements; press `c` to initiate capture, `a` to attack each round, or `d` to defend and `x` to leave if odds turn unfavorable.
cue: BoardingPanel open with favorable capture odds and spare crew above minimum.
done_check: Enemy crew drops to 0 and captured ship appears as a green ally in player fleet.

name: Hand-to-Hand Outfit Scaling
what: Purchases Fragmentation Grenades, Laser Rifles, or Security Stations in the Outfitter to boost crew attack and defense stats.
when: Preparing a ship for pirate capture farming or defending against boarders.
how: In Outfitter (`o`), select hand-to-hand outfits and press `b` to buy one per bunk.
cue: Planning to capture disabled ships or increase boarding defense.
done_check: Ship info shows increased capture attack/defense ratings.

name: Friendly Disabled Ship Repair
what: Boards a disabled friendly or escort vessel to restore enough hull for it to fly again.
when: An allied ship or mission NPC freighter (`npc save`) is disabled (grey on radar).
how: Target the disabled ally (`Shift+R` or `Shift+N` or `n`) and press `b`.
cue: Friendly or mission escort ship is grey on radar.
done_check: Ship docks briefly with the ally, ally regains hull, and its radar blip turns blue/green.

name: Hail Passing Ship for Help or Fuel
what: Opens communications with a friendly ship to request emergency fuel or hull repair when stranded or disabled.
when: Out of fuel (<100 units) or disabled in space with friendly ships nearby.
how: Target a friendly ship (`Shift+R`), press `t` to open HailPanel, then press `h` for help/fuel/repair.
cue: Stranded with low fuel or disabled hull while blue blips are present on radar.
done_check: Friendly ship approaches, docks with player, and transfers fuel or repairs hull.

name: Hail and Bribe Hostiles or Planets
what: Contacts a hostile ship or restricted planet and offers a credit bribe to cease attacks or grant landing access.
when: Overwhelmed by pirates with ample credits, or needing to land on a restricted planet.
how: Target hostile (`r`), press `t` to open HailPanel, press `b` or `o` to offer bribe (or `t` on planet hail to ask for fuel).
cue: Hostile threat cannot be outrun and player has spare credits.
done_check: Credits decrease and hostile radar blips turn blue/neutral (or planet grants landing permission).

name: Fleet Focus Fire Command
what: Orders all player escorts and fighters to focus fire on the flagship's current target.
when: Player has escorts/fighters and wants to burst down a priority enemy.
cue: Green escort blips on radar and a priority hostile is targeted.
done_check: Message log shows fleet focusing target and escorts turn toward the bracketed enemy.

name: Fleet Hold Position Command
what: Orders player escorts to stop and hold their current position in space.
when: Keeping vulnerable freighter escorts away from a brawl or setting up a defensive line.
cue: Fragile escorts are about to fly into enemy fire.
done_check: Message log confirms hold position and green escort blips decelerate to a stop.

name: Fleet Gather Command
what: Orders player escorts to return to the flagship and follow it.
when: Escorts are scattered after combat or holding position far away.
cue: Green escort blips are distant on radar or combat has ended.
done_check: Message log confirms gather command and escorts fly back toward the flagship.

name: Fleet Formation and Coordinated Jump
what: Toggles fleet formation flying or commands the entire fleet to jump together.
when: Traveling through dangerous systems with multiple escorts.
how: Press `Shift+G` to toggle formation; press `Shift+J` for fleet jump.
cue: Traveling with a multi-ship fleet across systems.
done_check: Escorts arrange in formation around flagship and jump simultaneously.

name: Park or Unpark Escorts in Player Info
what: Parks unused or fragile ships on a planet so they do not incur crew salaries or get destroyed in combat.
when: Landed on a planet with captured or unarmed ships you do not want in active space.
how: Press `i` to open PlayerInfo, select the ship in the fleet list, and toggle park.
cue: Owning extra captured ships or freighters before a combat mission.
done_check: Ship status in PlayerInfo shows parked and daily crew salary requirement drops.

name: NPC Freighter Escort Protection
what: Intercepts pirates attacking mission NPC freighters (e.g., `Intro [1 Interceptor]` with Sparrow 'Bloodletter' and Fury 'Hand of Fate') so the `npc save` freighters survive.
when: Running an escort mission where mission failure occurs if protected NPCs die.
how: Upon entering the ambush system, immediately press `r` to target the nearest pirate, close inside 300 px to draw aggro onto your shields, and destroy both attackers before landing.
cue: Active mission has `npc save` freighters and red/yellow pirate blips appear.
done_check: Pirates are destroyed, blue NPC freighter blips remain alive, and landing completes the mission.

name: Planetary Tribute Domination
what: Demands tribute from a planet and defeats its defense fleet to establish permanent daily credit income.
when: Endgame when commanding a massive warship fleet.
how: Target planet, press `t` to hail, demand tribute, defeat all spawning planetary defense ships, then hail again to accept surrender.
cue: Endgame fleet strength exceeds planetary defense fleet.
done_check: Planet surrenders and grants daily tribute credits.

name: New Pilot Creation and Intro Conversation
what: Creates a new pilot from the main menu or load panel, steps through the intro conversation, and enters the New Boston shipyard with 480,000 credits.
how: At Main Menu press `n` (or `l` then `n` if a pilot is loaded). Use Up/Down and Return through conversation choices. At the name prompt, type First Name, press `Tab` or `Return`, type Last Name, press `Return`, then press `Return` through the remaining dialogue until the Shipyard opens automatically.
cue: Main Menu or LoadPanel is visible at start of run.
done_check: New Boston Shipyard panel opens automatically showing 480,000 credits.

name: Load Existing Pilot
what: Loads a saved pilot from the main menu and enters the ship.
how: Press `l` or `m` on Main Menu, use `Up`/`Down` to select pilot, press `l` or `e` to load, and `e` on Main Menu to enter ship.
cue: Main Menu is open and save file exists.
done_check: Game transitions from menu to PlanetPanel or space.

name: Buy Sparrow in New Boston Shipyard
what: Selects and buys the Sparrow interceptor (third model in New Boston 'Basic Ships') for 442,000 credits including outfits, leaving 38,000 credits. Note: Disagreement between A and B — B states Sparrow costs 225,000 and uses Right arrow + Esc, whereas A verified on screen that 225,000 is the bare hull price while total shipyard cost with outfits is 442,000, Down arrow selects the third ship, `b` opens a ship name dialog, and `l` leaves.
when: Inside New Boston Shipyard immediately after the intro conversation.
how: Press `Down` twice to highlight the third ship (Sparrow), press `b` to buy, type a ship name and press `Return` to confirm the name dialog, then press `l` to leave the shipyard.
cue: New Boston Shipyard panel is open with 480,000 credits.
done_check: Credits read 38,000, Sparrow is owned, and leaving the shipyard (`l`) immediately triggers James's `Intro [0]` conversation without pressing `p`.

name: Accept James's Intro [0] Mission
what: Accepts James's automatic passenger mission (`Intro [0]`) to New Greenland (Arcturus system) for 10,000 credits upon leaving the initial shipyard. Note: Disagreement between A and B — B says to press `p` for Spaceport to trigger James, but A verified James's conversation pops up automatically upon leaving the shipyard.
when: Conversation panel with James opens right after leaving the New Boston shipyard.
how: Step through James's conversation using `Return` (choosing polite/accept options with `Up`/`Down` if needed) until the conversation closes on the PlanetPanel.
cue: James's dialogue panel appears after leaving the New Boston shipyard.
done_check: Conversation closes back to New Boston PlanetPanel and `Intro [0]` is active.

name: Plot Route to Unexplored System on Map
what: Plots a jump route to an unexplored adjacent system by clicking its screen offset on the map or walking seen links clockwise with the jump key. Note: Disagreement between A and B — B instructs pressing `f` in the map to search for 'New Greenland', but A verified in MapPanel::Find that `f` refuses unexplored systems (`player.CanView` is false) and searches system names rather than planet names.
when: Routing to a system that has not been visited yet (such as Arcturus for New Greenland from Rutilicus, or an unexplored bounty target system).
how: Press `m` to open MapPanel. Click the target system node at `window_centre + (target_pos - current_pos)` at zoom 1 (e.g., Rutilicus to Arcturus is offset `-54, -47` from window center), then press `m` or `Esc` to close the map.
cue: Destination system is grey/unexplored on the map so MapPanel Find (`f`) will not locate it.
done_check: Travel plan line highlights the link to the target system on the map.

name: Search Explored System on Map
what: Uses the map's Find dialog to center on an already-explored system.
when: Searching for a known, previously viewed system on the galaxy map.
how: Press `m` to open map, press `f`, type the explored system name, and press `Return`.
cue: Map is open and target system has already been explored (`player.CanView` is true).
done_check: Map view centers and selects the searched system.

name: Plain-Text Save File State and Job Parsing
what: Reads `%APPDATA%\endless-sky\saves\<First Last>.txt` upon landing to verify credits, hull, completed missions (`Intro [0]: done`), active mission targets, and `available job` blocks (including exact bounty NPC system names) without OCR errors.
when: Every time the ship lands on a planet.
how: Parse `%APPDATA%\endless-sky\saves\<First Last>.txt` for `account`, `system`, `planet`, `conditions`, `mission`, and `available job` blocks.
cue: Ship has just landed and PlanetPanel is visible.
done_check: Exact credits, mission flags, and bounty target system names are extracted deterministically.

name: Job Board Navigation and Bounty Acceptance
what: Opens the planetary Job Board, selects a target job such as `Bounty Hunting (Very Tiny)` ('Wanted fighter near <system>', 25,000 cr), and accepts it.
when: Landed on a planet (such as New Greenland after `Intro [0]`) looking for a paid bounty.
how: From PlanetPanel press `j` to open MissionPanel, use `Up`/`Down` to highlight the desired job (use `Left`/`Right` to switch between available and accepted lists), press `a` to accept, and press `l` or `d` to depart (or `Esc` to return to PlanetPanel).
cue: Landed on planet and save file or screen shows `Bounty Hunting (Very Tiny)` on the job board.
done_check: Job moves to the 'Accepted' list on screen.

name: Near-Term Win Playbook (Intro [0] + Paid Bounty)
what: Executes the full verified winning sequence: create pilot, buy Sparrow (442,000 cr), complete `Intro [0]` to New Greenland (+10,000 cr), accept and eliminate a `Bounty Hunting (Very Tiny)` Scrapper (+25,000 cr) or fallback `Intro [1 Interceptor]` (+35,000 cr), and land to write the proof save file.
when: Executing a full autonomous evaluation run from launch to completion.
how: 1) Create pilot (`n`), finish intro dialogue, buy Sparrow (`Down` x2, `b`, name, `Return`, `l`). 2) Accept James's auto-dialog (`Return`). 3) Open map (`m`), click Arcturus (`-54, -47` from center), close map (`m`), depart (`d`), jump/land (`j`), dismissing any help dialogs (`Return`). 4) On New Greenland, step through James's payment dialog (+10,000 cr), open job board (`j`), accept `Bounty Hunting (Very Tiny)` (`a`), plot route to bounty system on map, depart (`d`), and jump (`j`). 5) Press `r` to target the bounty Scrapper, hold `e` + `Up` to close within 300 px, hold `e` + `Tab` to destroy it, dismiss elimination dialog (`Return`), and press `l` to land and save.
cue: Autonomous run started from Main Menu.
done_check: Save file shows `Intro [0]: done`, increased credits, and bounty/escort completion.

name: Planet Panel Hub Hotkey Navigation
